close_reason: RFC 8621 §2.3 says sortAsTree is a sort-behavior modifier; unsupportedSort is correct per spec. Downgrading as opinion.
description: mailbox.rs line 173: when sortAsTree=true the handler returns JmapError::unsupported_sort(), but sortAsTree is a filter-semantics argument not a sort argument. RFC 8620 §5.5 does not specify which error to use for unsupported tree modes, but the existing code pattern returns unsupported_filter for filterAsTree and unsupported_sort for sortAsTree. The inconsistency means a client that checks error types to distinguish unsupportedSort from unsupportedFilter will misinterpret the rejection of sortAsTree=true as a sort rejection, not a feature rejection.
title: sortAsTree=true returns wrong error type
